description: Unit tests for google_breakpad::MemoryRange class, testing memory range operations such as subranges, data access, and element retrieval.

methods.name: MemoryRange::Reset
methods.description: Resets the memory range to empty state.

methods.name: MemoryRange::Set
methods.description: Sets the memory range to a new data pointer and size.

methods.name: MemoryRange::Subrange
methods.description: Returns a subrange of the current memory range.

methods.name: MemoryRange::data
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the data in the memory range.

methods.name: MemoryRange::length
methods.description: Returns the size of the memory range.

methods.name: MemoryRange::GetData
methods.description: Returns a pointer to a specific data segment within the range.

methods.name: MemoryRange::GetArrayElement
methods.description: Retrieves a pointer to an array element at a given index.
